info.title: Switch Hero
info.author: Rodrigo Ferreira
info.description: A rythm game for Nintendo Switch
info.details:
Switch Hero is a rhythm game built for Nintendo Switch, designed for both standard controllers and guitar controllers.

Inspired by classic guitar rhythm games, Switch Hero brings fast, arcade-style note highway gameplay to the Switch with support for Joy-Con, Pro Controller, and compatible Wii guitar controllers.

The game supports Clone Hero-style custom song libraries, allowing players to bring their existing songs and charts into a portable console experience.

Features include:

• Joy-Con and Pro Controller support
• Compatible Wii guitar controller support
• Custom songs and charts
• Clone Hero-compatible song structure
• Multiple difficulty levels
• Score tracking and performance feedback
• Classic five-lane rhythm gameplay
• Responsive gameplay designed specifically for Nintendo Switch

Whether you're playing casually with a controller or using a guitar for the full rhythm-game experience, Switch Hero is built to make custom rhythm gaming portable.
